cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: The Conspiracy Expands
cards.instruction: Use every denial, coincidence, and missing detail as proof that more people and higher stakes are involved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Our toaster receipt is gone. The shop must have someone inside this house.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I probably recycled it. We can get a copy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. So the recycling crew removes originals while the shop prints replacements.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Every shop? Then it's the whole high street. We can't trust a single warranty.

mechanism: A corrects a household partner's evidence handling while expanding a missing receipt into organized warranty fraud.
confusable: Ordinary caution does not widen the plot after every reassurance; each B explanation must enlarge the alleged network.
comparison: A shared household object and records differ from a traveler accusing a transport worker.
seedUse: Use replacement receipt and recycling as false evidence, adding corrective investigative conduct.
